title: Maple Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Soft blender pancakes that work for busy mornings.
steps: Blend bananas, eggs, oats, baking powder, and salt until smooth.
Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium heat.
Pour small rounds and cook 2 minutes per side.

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Bowls
description: Meal-prep friendly chicken bowls for lunch or dinner.
steps: Mix olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Coat chicken and marinate for 20 minutes.
Bake at 425F for 22-25 minutes until fully cooked.
Slice chicken and serve over rice.

title: Weeknight Beef Taco Skillet
description: Quick one-pan beef taco filling for tacos or bowls.
ingredients: Corn tortillas or rice for serving
steps: Cook onion and beef in a skillet until browned.
Drain excess fat and add taco seasoning.
Stir in salsa and black beans and simmer for 8 minutes.
Serve in tortillas or over rice.

title: Simple Gluten-Free Pasta Primavera
description: Colorful pasta dinner with fast-sauteed vegetables.
steps: Cook pasta according to package directions.
Saute vegetables in olive oil for 5-6 minutes.
Toss vegetables with drained pasta and season to taste.
